groups.name: raf.okhttp
groups.description: OkHttp client configuration for third-party API calls.

properties.name: raf.okhttp.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the OkHttp client integration.

properties.name: raf.okhttp.max-idle-connections
properties.description: Maximum number of idle connections in the connection pool.

properties.name: raf.okhttp.keep-alive-duration
properties.description: Keep-alive duration in seconds for idle connections.

properties.name: raf.okhttp.retry-on-connection-failure
properties.description: Whether to retry requests on connection failure.

properties.name: raf.okhttp.max-requests
properties.description: Maximum number of concurrent requests across all hosts.

properties.name: raf.okhttp.max-requests-per-host
properties.description: Maximum number of concurrent requests per host.
